messages:
jiwoo: FYI — onboarding veridian-lite-v2 (int4). Quick smoke eval shows weird subtoken splits for vertical/ruby text and punctuation merging on Arabic. Need eyes :eyes:

tao: can you paste the eval numbers + tokenizer diff?

jiwoo: sure, dumping run and a tiny tokenizer sample:
```
$ ./bench/eval_mt.sh --model veridian-lite-v2 --quant int4 --sets zh-ja,ja-en,ar-en
Results:
ja->en BLEU: base=27.8 int4=24.5 delta=-3.3
zh->ja BLEU: base=31.0 int4=26.4 delta=-4.6
ar->en BLEU: base=29.0 int4=25.7 delta=-3.3
avg chrF: base=56.2 int4=54.1 (-2.1)

Tokenizer diff (example: “東京駅。” / `東京駅。`):
base tokens: [TOK(1023)=東京, TOK(45)=駅, TOK(999)=。]
int4 tokens: [TOK(1023)=東, TOK(78)=京駅, TOK(999)=。]

Notes: kernel auto-selection used; no special pre/post detok flags.
```

marta: that token boundary shift looks like a subtokenization change, not just detok. could be model quant packing altering merge heuristics.

samir: did the run enable continuous-batching / kv-cache padding? and which kernel path was chosen?

jiwoo: no kv-cache change compared to baseline. auto-kernel reported: `quant-kernel-v1 -> fallback:mixed-width-conv(block=32)` in logs. suspect pack/unpack rounding in the mixed-width path.

tao: try rerun with `--force-kernel=stable-int8` and `--disable-auto-slim` to force the older path, see if it repros.

jiwoo: kicking that now, small smoke queued. will post back in ~5m.

eval-bot: rerun complete for thread 2712345678 — summary:
ja->en BLEU (int4 + stable-int8 kernel): 26.9 (was 24.5)
zh->ja BLEU: 28.9 (was 26.4)
ar->en BLEU: 27.8 (was 25.7)
Token map comparison: majority of samples now match base token boundaries; remaining diffs concentrated on mixed-width ruby annotations and fullwidth punctuation clusters.
Action: flagged P1 for quant path kernel selection. /cc @samir @tao

samir: if forcing stable-int8 restores most quality, kernel router likely misclassifying some model shapes for mixed-width pack. filing INF ticket: <https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4321|INF-4321> and attaching the tokenizer diffs + run logs.

marta: also add focused vertical-ruby and arabic-punct testcases to the nightly eval harness so regressions catch earlier. small set of 120 examples should do.

jiwoo: added `qa/cases/intl/vertical_ruby_and_arabic_punct.jsonl` (120 cases) and requeued nightly. thanks all :thumbsup:
